name: erp-crm-platform
description: A multi-tenant ERP and CRM platform built for learning and scale.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
